concerns.text: The plan describes downloading climate rasters but never creates or validates a climate raster metadata file required by the `climate_raster.schema.yaml` contract. No artifact matching this schema is mentioned, violating the contract‑exercise rule.

The plan outputs `metrics/model_performance.json` (ModelMetrics) but does not produce a `performance_metric` artifact required by `performance_metric.schema.yaml`. The contract is therefore unexercised.

The `ModelMetrics` schema defines a `delta_auc` field, yet the plan only computes and reports `delta_Suitability`. This mismatch means the plan will not generate data conforming to the declared schema.
